name: file-manager
title: File Manager
description: A complete storage app for Next.js: overview with storage and member status, my files, shared, favorites, recent, trash and folder pages. Search, upload, rename, sort, list and grid all work.
docs:
Installs a full app under app/file-manager. Run your dev server and open /file-manager.

It uses these theme tokens: background, card, muted, accent, border, primary, destructive and chart-1 to chart-5.
